methods.docs:
Start an in-process HTTP server in native code (not the WebView). Binds to loopback by default.
Uses the same GGUF stack as initContext; exposes GET /health, GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions (OpenAI-shaped).
This is a lightweight cpp-httplib server — not the full upstream llama.cpp `llama-server` executable.

text
properties.docs: Original text (Ignored reasoning_content / tool_calls)

properties.name: reasoning_content

properties.docs: Tool calls (parsed from response)

properties.name: content
properties.docs: Content text (Filtered text by reasoning_content / tool_calls)

properties.name: jinja
properties.docs: Enable Jinja. Default: true if supported by the model

properties.name: json_schema
properties.docs:
JSON schema for convert to grammar for structured JSON output.
It will be override by grammar if both are set.

properties.name: grammar
properties.docs:
Set grammar for grammar-based sampling (GBNF format). Default: no grammar
This will override json_schema if both are provided.

properties.name: grammar_lazy
properties.docs: Lazy grammar sampling, trigger by grammar_triggers. Default: false

properties.name: enable_thinking
properties.docs: Enable thinking if jinja is enabled. Default: true

properties.name: thinking_forced_open
properties.docs: Force thinking to be open. Default: false

properties.name: grammar_triggers
properties.docs: Lazy grammar triggers. Default: []

properties.name: media_paths
properties.docs:
Path to an image file to process before generating text.
When provided, the image will be processed and added to the context.
Requires multimodal support to be enabled via initMultimodal.

properties.name: stop
properties.docs:
Specify a JSON array of stopping strings.
These words will not be included in the completion, so make sure to add them to the prompt for the next iteration. Default: `[]`

properties.name: n_predict
properties.docs:
Set the maximum number of tokens to predict when generating text.
**Note:** May exceed the set limit slightly if the last token is a partial multibyte character.
When 0,no tokens will be generated but the prompt is evaluated into the cache. Default: `-1`, where `-1` is infinity.

properties.name: n_probs
properties.docs:
If greater than 0, the response also contains the probabilities of top N tokens for each generated token given the sampling settings.
Note that for temperature < 0 the tokens are sampled greedily but token probabilities are still being calculated via a simple softmax of the logits without considering any other sampler settings.
Default: `0`

properties.name: top_k
properties.docs: Limit the next token selection to the K most probable tokens.  Default: `40`

properties.name: top_p
properties.docs: Limit the next token selection to a subset of tokens with a cumulative probability above a threshold P. Default: `0.95`

properties.name: min_p
properties.docs: The minimum probability for a token to be considered, relative to the probability of the most likely token. Default: `0.05`

properties.name: xtc_probability
properties.docs: Set the chance for token removal via XTC sampler. Default: `0.0`, which is disabled.

properties.name: xtc_threshold
properties.docs: Set a minimum probability threshold for tokens to be removed via XTC sampler. Default: `0.1` (> `0.5` disables XTC)

properties.name: typical_p
properties.docs: Enable locally typical sampling with parameter p. Default: `1.0`, which is disabled.

properties.name: temperature
properties.docs: Adjust the randomness of the generated text. Default: `0.8`

properties.name: penalty_last_n
properties.docs: Last n tokens to consider for penalizing repetition. Default: `64`, where `0` is disabled and `-1` is ctx-size.

properties.name: penalty_repeat
properties.docs: Control the repetition of token sequences in the generated text. Default: `1.0`

properties.name: penalty_freq
properties.docs: Repeat alpha frequency penalty. Default: `0.0`, which is disabled.

properties.name: penalty_present
properties.docs: Repeat alpha presence penalty. Default: `0.0`, which is disabled.

properties.name: mirostat
properties.docs: Enable Mirostat sampling, controlling perplexity during text generation. Default: `0`, where `0` is disabled, `1` is Mirostat, and `2` is Mirostat 2.0.

properties.name: mirostat_tau
properties.docs: Set the Mirostat target entropy, parameter tau. Default: `5.0`

properties.name: mirostat_eta
properties.docs: Set the Mirostat learning rate, parameter eta. Default: `0.1`

properties.name: dry_multiplier
properties.docs: Set the DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) repetition penalty multiplier. Default: `0.0`, which is disabled.

properties.name: dry_base
properties.docs: Set the DRY repetition penalty base value. Default: `1.75`

properties.name: dry_allowed_length
properties.docs: Tokens that extend repetition beyond this receive exponentially increasing penalty: multiplier * base ^ (length of repeating sequence before token - allowed length). Default: `2`

properties.name: dry_penalty_last_n
properties.docs: How many tokens to scan for repetitions. Default: `-1`, where `0` is disabled and `-1` is context size.

properties.name: dry_sequence_breakers
properties.docs: Specify an array of sequence breakers for DRY sampling. Only a JSON array of strings is accepted. Default: `['\n', ':', '"', '*']`

properties.name: top_n_sigma
properties.docs: Top n sigma sampling as described in academic paper "Top-nσ: Not All Logits Are You Need" https://arxiv.org/pdf/2411.07641. Default: `-1.0` (Disabled)

properties.name: ignore_eos
properties.docs: Ignore end of stream token and continue generating. Default: `false`

properties.name: logit_bias
properties.docs:
Modify the likelihood of a token appearing in the generated text completion.
For example, use `"logit_bias": [[15043,1.0]]` to increase the likelihood of the token 'Hello', or `"logit_bias": [[15043,-1.0]]` to decrease its likelihood.
Setting the value to false, `"logit_bias": [[15043,false]]` ensures that the token `Hello` is never produced. The tokens can also be represented as strings,
e.g.`[["Hello, World!",-0.5]]` will reduce the likelihood of all the individual tokens that represent the string `Hello, World!`, just like the `presence_penalty` does.
Default: `[]`

properties.name: seed
properties.docs: Set the random number generator (RNG) seed. Default: `-1`, which is a random seed.

properties.name: guide_tokens
properties.docs:
Guide tokens for the completion.
Help prevent hallucinations by forcing the TTS to use the correct words.
Default: `[]`
